pr_title: Fix run exported jobs error for completedAt

issue_context.title: `gh run view --json jobs` reports inaccurate completedAt datetimes
issue_context.body:
### Describe the bug

GitHub Actions workflow run job data is reporting the same `completedAt` datetime for all jobs.

```shell
$ gh version
gh version 2.40.0 (2023-12-07)
https://github.com/cli/cli/releases/tag/v2.40.0
```

### Steps to reproduce the behavior

1. Create or locate a GitHub Actions workflow run with multiple jobs such as [GitHub CLI deployment workflow run from `v2.40.0` release _(ID: 7129911022)_](https://github.com/cli/cli/actions/runs/7129911022)
2. View summarized workflow run jobs' elapsed time using `gh run view`
   _Notice how the `windows` job is significantly longer than the others_

   ```shell
   $ gh run view 7129911022 --repo cli/cli
   
   ✓ trunk Deployment · 7129911022
   Triggered via workflow_dispatch about 3 days ago
   
   JOBS
   ✓ macos in 3m7s (ID 19415069602)
   ✓ linux in 3m47s (ID 19415070171)
   ✓ windows in 5m43s (ID 19415070577)
   ✓ release in 4m4s (ID 19415345577)
   
   ARTIFACTS
   linux
   macos
   windows
   
   For more information about a job, try: gh run view --job=<job-id>
   View this run on GitHub: https://github.com/cli/cli/actions/runs/7129911022
   ```
3. Export workflow run jobs and notice how all jobs are completed at the same time _(`2023-12-07T15:06:48Z`)_

   ```shell
   $ gh run view 7129911022 --json jobs --repo cli/cli | jq
   ```
